label: Search index definition (JSON)
type: the portable JSON artifact both export-search-index.md and import-search-index.md operate on - copy/paste between the Web Console, the REST API, or another cluster. Import explicitly supports index ALIASES as well as indexes; export's own wording does not state whether alias definitions are exportable the same way.
evidence: Use the Couchbase Server Web Console to copy and paste a JSON Search index definition for use in the REST API or another cluster.
In the Import Index window, paste the JSON definition of your Search index or index alias.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a Search index's full definition be moved between clusters or into version control as a portable artifact?
